source: llama-server --help captured from this exact build: version 0.4.1-dev (build 11071, commit 6ad1af560), built with GNU 13.3.0 for Linux aarch64, CUDA 13.0, -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DGGML_CUDA_GRAPHS=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=121.
notes: Upstream release tag b11071 (commit 6ad1af56033cc9d4cecacf574ac8af8eb4b3249e). Parsed with the help-text ingester, then corrected by hand where the parser misreads this build's help format: flags written as `--x, --no-x` (jinja, reasoning-preserve, kv-unified) and enum flags written as `[on|off|auto]` (flash-attn, fit, reasoning) were typed bool/false or dropped, so they are re-entered here with the defaults the help text states; load-mode and lazy-mode were re-entered with their full choice lists; string-valued flags the parser typed bool were retyped str with a null default; six unparseable names (a blank, `cpu-strict)`, `threads)` and three `spec-ngram-*` patterns) were removed. Note for anyone comparing with older builds: this build has no --no-mmap; the equivalent is --load-mode none. kv-unified has a null default because its default depends on --parallel.
